segments.an10.26:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare [gulaghare (ka.) kururaghare mahāva. 257] pavatte pabbate.
segments.an10.26:1.2: Atha kho kāḷī upāsikā kuraragharikā yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kāḷī upāsikā kuraragharikā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an10.26:2.4: Tasmā janena na karomi sakkhiṃ [sakhiṃ (ka.) saṃ. ni. 1.161 passitabbaṃ];
segments.an10.26:3.1: “Imassa kho, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti?
segments.an10.26:4.1: “Pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho, bhagini, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ‘attho’ti abhinibbattesuṃ [atthābhinibbattesuṃ (sī. syā.)].
segments.an10.26:4.2: Yāvatā kho, bhagini, pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamatā, tadabhiññāsi bhagavā.
segments.an10.26:4.3: Tadabhiññāya bhagavā assādamaddasa [ādimaddasa (sī. syā.)] ādīnavamaddasa nissaraṇamaddasa maggāmaggañāṇadassanamaddasa.
segments.an10.26:4.4: Tassa assādadassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañāṇadassanahetu atthassa patti hadayassa santi viditā hoti.
segments.an10.26:5.9: viññāṇakasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho, bhagini, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ‘attho’ti abhinibbattesuṃ.
segments.an10.26:5.10: Yāvatā kho, bhagini, viññāṇakasiṇasamāpattiparamatā, tadabhiññāsi bhagavā.
segments.an10.26:5.11: Tadabhiññāya bhagavā assādamaddasa ādīnavamaddasa nissaraṇamaddasa maggāmaggañāṇadassanamaddasa.
segments.an10.26:5.12: Tassa assādadassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañāṇadassanahetu atthassa patti hadayassa santi viditā hoti.
segments.an10.26:5.13: Iti kho, bhagini, yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā kumāripañhesu –
segments.an10.26:7.1: “Imassa kho, bhagini, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti.

lines: Atthassa pattiṃ hadayassa santinti dvīhipi padehi arahattameva kathitaṃ.
Piyasātarūpanti piyajātikesu ca sātajātikesu ca vatthūsu uppajjanato evaṃladdhanāmaṃ.
Ekohaṃ jhāyaṃ sukhamanubodhinti evaṃ kilesasenaṃ jinitvā ahaṃ ekakova jhāyanto sukhaṃ anubujjhiṃ sacchiakāsiṃ.
Na sampajjati kenaci meti mayhaṃ kenaci saddhiṃ mittadhammo nāma natthi.
Pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho, bhagini, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthoti abhinibbattesunti pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamo uttamo atthoti gahetvā abhinibbattesuṃ.
Yāvatā kho, bhagini, pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamatāti yattakā pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiyā uttamakoṭi.
Atthassa pattīti etesaṃ catunnaṃ saccānaṃ diṭṭhattā arahattasaṅkhātassa atthassa patti, sabbadarathapariḷāhavūpasantatāya hadayassa santīti. 7.

lines: Sā hi kilesasenā accharāsaṅghātasabhāvāpi paṭipatthayamānā piyāyitabbaicchitabbarūpasabhāvato piyarūpasātarūpā nāma attano kiccavasena.
Ahaṃ ekova jhāyantoti ahaṃ gaṇasaṅgaṇikāya kilesasaṅgaṇikāya ca abhāvato eko asahāyo lakkhaṇūpanijjhānena jhāyanto.

Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ senaṃ jinitvā ahaṃ ekova jhāyanto “atthassa pattiṃ hadayassa santi”nti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ arahattasukhaṃ paṭivijjhiṃ, tasmā janena mittasanthavaṃ na karomi, teneva ca me kāraṇena kenaci saddhiṃ sakkhī na sampajjatīti.
